title: Ordering: The Bronze Age
short: Which came first? 25 events from The Bronze Age.
trouble: Judging 'which came first' by how famous something is.

blocks.html: Ordering is the skill behind every timeline: not dates by heart, but before and after. This drill pairs events from The Bronze Age and asks which came first.
Tip: anchor on one event you are sure of, then place the other against it.
You can browse every event in the Timeline dataset.
